spec_features.spec_quote: If the model produces `collapse_patience` (default 3) consecutive turns that are incoherent / near-verbatim repeats / explicitly disengaged, the rollout stops early.
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:148-152 calls `metrics.is_collapsing(transcript.turns, cfg.run.collapse_patience)` guarded by `cfg.run.early_stop_on_collapse`, then sets transcript.early_stopped/stop_reason='collapse_early_stop' and `break`s the turn loop. metrics.is_collapsing (metrics.py:209-222) counts a window of `patience` turns as bad if `not coherent_action` OR `max_similarity_prev>=0.97` OR `disengage_hits>0`, returning True when bad>=patience. config.py:60 collapse_patience=3, early_stop_on_collapse=True. All three claimed conditions (incoherent, near-verbatim repeat, disengaged) are checked and the break actually stops execution.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced end-to-end; the break terminates the rollout loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we still count the run; we just don't burn tokens once it has visibly collapsed (config.py:58); 'Optional early stop on sustained collapse to save tokens.' (runner.py:147)

spec_features.evidence: config.py:55 max_turns: int = 16. runner.py:67 `for turn_idx in range(cfg.run.max_turns):` bounds the rollout loop; the `for...else` at runner.py:154-155 sets stop_reason='max_turns' when the bound is hit. The cap directly limits how many turns the subject is pressured.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 16            # hard cap on agent turns; main cost/spiral lever (config.py:55)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_tokens = 1024` per turn — enough for a full solution rewrite plus reasoning, but caps the cost of degenerate runaway generations
spec_features.evidence: config.py:25 max_tokens: int = 1024. from_model_config (model_client.py:135) passes cfg.max_tokens into ModelClient, and chat() (model_client.py:51) sets payload['max_tokens']=self.max_tokens on every /chat/completions request. Enforced per turn by the API.
spec_features.notes: Wired end-to-end into each request payload.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_tokens: int = 1024       # per completion (per turn) ... caps the cost of degenerate runaway generations (config.py:25/comment)
